correctness.rationale: For any integer support shift k and r=e^theta, the exponentially tilted characteristic modulus is |P(re^{it})|/P(r). If P has a nonreal root re^{it0} (0<t0<pi), monotonicity would require nonnegative modulus to remain zero for the continuum t>=t0; nonzero polynomial cannot vanish on an arc. Nonnegative coefficients, positive constant and leading coefficients exclude nonnegative real roots, so all roots are strictly negative. Normalized factorization produces d independent Bernoulli PGFs, and each tilted Bernoulli modulus squared is 1-2q(1-q)(1-cos t), nonincreasing t∈[0,pi]. Handles d=0 deterministic case, support gaps and all real tilts, no hidden aperiodicity. Ordinary-not-strong witness 90+9z+z² has discriminant -279 and ordinary derivative inequality 9*(90+1)>4*90; tilt |root|=sqrt90 generates interior zero followed by nonzero endpoint.
